answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil floods by making influence depend on a slashable, time-locked bond plus grades from already-established panels. A fresh clone cannot mint a trustworthy signal in one epoch: its ledger looks sable until a saffron trail of countersigned, settled work stretches across many rounds. Farmed copies fail because they lack locked history, and coordinated clusters can be slashed once detected, so cheap volume never buys consensus weight.
